The Collection

Six Wild
Fragrances

Each scent is a landscape held in suspension — drawn from the bogs, shorelines, and night-gardens of the far north. Distilled in copper. Bottled in editions of three hundred.

Our six fragrances are built from raw botanical extracts — no synthetic musks, no petrochemical fixatives. Each formula is the result of years of field sourcing and iterative distillation. We do not rush them.

Filter by family

Noctiluca

Aquatic · Marine · Mineral

Named for the sea-fire that lights the shallows on still August nights off the Caithness coast. Cold, sparkling, alive — and gone by morning. A scent for those who have walked alone at 2 a.m. and been startled by beauty.

Top Sea spray, cold ozone, bergamot zest
Heart Crystalline salt, driftwood, white iris
Base White musk, ambergris accord, cedarwood

£185 · 50ml EDP

Ambarvalia

Earthy · Smoky · Balsamic

The Roman Ambarvalia was a walking ceremony of consecration — priests circling the fields at harvest's end, burning offerings at each corner. This fragrance is that smoke, those baked fields, the old stone walls still warm at sundown.

Top Burnt hay, beeswax, dry chamomile
Heart Smoked stone, helichrysum, labdanum
Base Warm amber, benzoin, oakmoss, vetiver

£195 · 50ml EDP

Sphagnum

Earthy · Green · Resinous

Sphagnum moss holds up to twenty times its weight in water. This fragrance holds the memory of rain: cold peat, silver birch bark, the particular green of heather after a long soaking. Rich, resinous, utterly northern.

Top Rain accord, green heather, blackcurrant bud
Heart Wet peat, silver birch, galbanum
Base Lichen absolute, fir resin, smoky vetiver

£190 · 50ml EDP

Miriam's Garden

Floral · Green · Woody-Earthy

Named for Miriam Gault's grandmother, who kept a walled garden in Orkney where roses and fig trees improbably thrived. The fig tree has since died. The smell of it — that particular combination of milk, leaf, and warm earth — has not.

Top Fig leaf, green tomato, lemon blossom
Heart White rose absolute, fig milk, geranium
Base Warm earth, oakmoss, tonka bean, sandalwood

£210 · 50ml EDP

The Moth Hour

Woody · Floral · Oriental

The hour between midnight and first light, when the large moths are active and the jasmine in the south-facing beds releases everything it has held through the heat of the day. Heady, dark, consoling.

Top Night-blooming jasmine, cardamom, black pepper
Heart Dark amber, tuberose, ylang ylang
Base Cedarwood, vetiver, labdanum, oud accord

£225 · 50ml EDP

Loch Asymptote

Woody · Aquatic · Green

An asymptote approaches without arriving. This fragrance approaches the smell of a particular highland loch — Loch More, in north Sutherland — without ever quite landing. You chase it. Cold pine resin, deep cold water, rain on rock.

Top Rain, cold mineral spring, highland pine
Heart Mist accord, fir needle, green tea
Base Cedarwood, grey musk, moss accord, ambergris

£185 · 50ml EDP

Bespoke

A Fragrance
Made for One

Each year we accept three commissions for entirely bespoke fragrances. This is a twelve-month process: field visits, correspondence, two rounds of trials, and a final edition of twelve numbered bottles. It is not for everyone.
